testCases.title: Successful Search with Valid Keyword
steps: Enter a valid search keyword into the search field.
expectedResults: The search results display relevant content based on the valid keyword.

testCases.title: Search with Invalid Keyword Returns No Results
steps: Enter an invalid search keyword into the search field.
expectedResults: The system displays a message indicating that no results were found.

testCases.title: Feedback on Empty Search Keyword
expectedResults: The system displays appropriate feedback indicating that no keywords were entered.
